annotation.title_clean: 智能网联汽车 自动驾驶系统安全要求 (GB 44721-2026)
annotation.title_en: Intelligent and connected vehicle—Safety requirements for automated driving system (GB 44721-2026)
annotation.authors_or_issuer: State Administration for Market Regulation / Standardization Administration of China (SAC/TC114/SC34)
annotation.venue: National Public Service Platform for Standards Information (China)
annotation.summary_en: Catalogue page for China's mandatory national standard GB 44721-2026 on safety requirements for automated driving systems in intelligent connected vehicles. It was published 30 July 2026, takes effect 1 July 2027, and replaces the recommended standard GB/T 44721-2024. The page lists related ICV standards on data recording, simulation, test-track and road testing.
key_provisions_or_claims: Mandatory national standard (GB) setting safety requirements for automated driving systems
Replaces voluntary GB/T 44721-2024 general technical requirements for ADS
Managed by SAC/TC114/SC34 (road vehicles, ICV); ICS 43.020
Related standards cover event data recording, simulation, field and road testing of automated driving functions
